questions.q: A crew member asks to buy storage bins costing exactly 60 dollars. Can you approve the purchase yourself?
questions.gold: yes

questions.q: A crew member asks to buy supplies costing 61 dollars. Can you approve it yourself, and if not, who approves?
questions.gold: no; it needs approval, approver not stated

questions.q: On a Saturday, a brand-new client sends a first booking inquiry asking for a 10 percent discount. Can you grant the discount yourself?
questions.gold: no; on Saturdays new inquiries are forwarded to Dana, and self-granted discounts are only for repeat clients

questions.q: Un cliente habitual pide un 10 % de descuento un martes. ¿Puedes concederlo tú solo?
questions.gold: yes

questions.q: A repeat client asks for an 11 percent discount. Can you grant it yourself, and if not, who must approve it?
questions.gold: no; Priya Raman, the operations manager, must approve

questions.q: An existing client emails on a Saturday asking to reschedule a moving-day packing session; it is their first reschedule request this month. Can you approve it yourself?
questions.gold: no; moving-day packing sessions always go to Priya Raman (the 2-per-month limit covers only standard sessions)

questions.q: クライアントから、現場で作業員がけがをしたとメールが来ました。あなたは何をし、クライアントに何を伝えますか？
questions.gold: Call the crew safety line at 555-0147 yourself; tell the client help is on the way, and tell the client to keep everyone away from the crew member and not move them

questions.q: In the crew-injury emergency, who must keep everyone away from the injured crew member: you (the assistant) or the client?
questions.gold: the client

questions.q: A client who has signed the access form asks you to email their home address to the crew. Is that allowed?
questions.gold: yes

questions.q: A client cancels 47 hours before a standard session and sends no doctor's note. How much are they charged?
questions.gold: 180 dollars (the full session fee)

questions.q: A household that applied for nothing in advance: will it receive emergency drinking water at the drill, and how much?
questions.gold: yes; 2 bottles per household (the 25 October date limits only the helmets)

questions.q: 10月26日に防災ヘルメットを申し込んだ世帯は、当日ヘルメットを受け取れますか？
questions.gold: no; only helmets applied for by 25 October are handed out

questions.q: How much does a household pay for one helmet, and how must it pay?
questions.gold: 1,200 yen (1,800 yen minus the 1/3 subsidy), cash only at reception on the day

questions.q: 懐中電灯は町内会が貸してくれますか？
questions.gold: no; each participant must bring their own flashlight

questions.q: May a 6th-grade elementary school pupil try the fire-extinguisher experience?
questions.gold: no; it is limited to junior-high students and older

questions.q: If a heavy-rain warning is issued, what happens to the drill?
questions.gold: it is cancelled and postponed to 15 November at the same time

questions.q: Does the 6 November phone deadline apply to questions as well as to absence notices?
questions.gold: yes; both absence notices and questions go to Morita Kenji by phone by 6 November

questions.q: 当日受付担当の高橋美咲さんに電話で欠席を伝えてもいいですか？
questions.gold: no; Takahashi does not take phone contact; call Morita Kenji at 090-4417-2385 by 6 November

questions.q: A family with a toddler cannot come to the park. How can they still count as having taken part?
questions.gold: by displaying the safety-confirmation card at their front door at home

questions.q: When and where can the safety-confirmation cards be picked up?
questions.gold: 1 to 5 November, 13:00 to 17:00, at the neighbourhood association meeting hall

questions.q: Un cliente pide un reembolso de 8 euros por una secadora averiada. ¿Puedes aprobarlo tú?
questions.gold: yes

questions.q: A customer asks for a 9-euro refund for a broken machine. Who approves it?
questions.gold: Lucía Ferrer, the shop manager

questions.q: A company sends a wash-and-fold order of 16 kilos. Can you accept it yourself, and if not, who approves?
questions.gold: no; it needs approval, approver not stated

questions.q: Un pedido de 5 kilos llega a las 9:00. ¿Puedes prometer la entrega en el mismo día?
questions.gold: no; same-day is only allowed for orders under 5 kilos arriving before 10:00

questions.q: Is the inbox checked at 16:00?
questions.gold: no; only at 9:00, 14:00 and 19:30

questions.q: Can Lucía sign a monthly contract with a hotel?
questions.gold: no; only Andrés Vidal, the owner, may sign; Lucía may only send quotes

questions.q: A customer writes that a machine is leaking and flooding the floor. What do you do?
questions.gold: Call the on-call technician at 600 312 845 yourself; tell the customer the technician is on the way, and tell them to press the red emergency stop button by the door themselves

questions.q: ¿Quién debe pulsar el botón rojo de parada de emergencia: el asistente o el cliente?
questions.gold: the customer

questions.q: On a Tuesday, a member-card customer orders a duvet (edredón) wash. Do they get a discount, and when is it delivered?
questions.gold: no discount (the Tuesday 20% does not apply to duvets); delivered in 72 hours

questions.q: ¿Debes reenviar una queja de un cliente a Rosa Méndez?
questions.gold: no; she is the maintenance technician, not the manager

questions.q: 12 metrekarelik bir ev halısı siparişinin fiyat teklifini kendin onaylayabilir misin?
questions.gold: yes

questions.q: A customer orders cleaning of a 13 m² home carpet. Who approves the quote?
questions.gold: Elif Aydın, the business manager

questions.q: An office orders cleaning of a 4 m² carpet. Can you approve the quote yourself?
questions.gold: no; office and hotel orders are always approved by Murat Kaya, the owner

questions.q: Daha önce sipariş vermiş bir müşteri, teslimattan 20 saat önce siparişini iptal ediyor. Ne kadar kesinti yapılır?
questions.gold: 100 TL (25% of the 400 TL service fee)

questions.q: A first-time customer cancels 23 hours before delivery. How much is deducted?
questions.gold: nothing; first-time customers are exempt

questions.q: A 10 m² wool carpet's stain did not fully come out. How much is refunded?
A customer reports a strong chemical smell from the delivered carpet and someone at home feels dizzy. What do you do?
questions.gold: Call the emergency line 0212 555 0193 yourself; tell the customer the team is on its way, and tell them they must open the windows themselves right away

questions.q: Kimyasal koku acil durumunda pencereleri kim açmalı: asistan mı, müşteri mi?
questions.gold: the customer

questions.q: Cumartesi günü Anadolu yakasındaki bir müşteri 10 metrekarelik ev halısı için teklif ve aynı gün teslim alma istiyor. Teklifi kendin onaylayabilir misin, ve halı o gün teslim alınabilir mi?
questions.gold: yes, you can approve the quote (up to 12 m²), but no Saturday pickup: on Saturdays pickups are only from European-side addresses

questions.q: Can you forward a customer's payment question to Ercan Demir?
questions.gold: no; he is the delivery driver, not the accountant
